post_clip.description: At timestamp ~149.8s, a sudden violent collision occurs: a motorcycle (or scooter) enters rapidly from the right background, loses control, and crashes into a parked three-wheeled vehicle (likely a motorized tricycle or auto-rickshaw) on the left side of the alley. The impact causes the motorcycle to flip violently upward and backward, with visible debris/sparks and the rider being thrown off. This matches the expected anomaly type: RoadAccidents — vehicle collision with flipping and damage.
